bibl.title: Sappho's "Brothers Poem": An Interpretation.

bibl.note: P. Coll. privées [P. Sapph. Obbink] (= MP3 1445.02; LDAB 341738). - The poem is organized through an intricate and semantically significant web of interwoven verbal repetitions that produce an overall meaning which is perhaps the most profound in all of Sappho's extant work.
